name: Fatigue & Failure Analysis
summary: Covers failure under cyclic loading and the forensic methods used to find out why real components broke.

topics.name: Cyclic stresses: amplitude, mean stress and stress ratio
Stress-life (S-N) approach and endurance limit; mean-stress corrections (Goodman, Gerber)
Strain-life approach: Coffin-Manson and cyclic stress-strain behaviour
Fatigue crack initiation: persistent slip bands, notches and surface effects
Fatigue crack growth: Paris law, threshold and crack closure
Variable-amplitude loading and cumulative damage (Miner's rule)
Factors affecting fatigue life: surface finish, residual stresses, shot peening, environment
Thermal and thermomechanical fatigue; fretting fatigue
Fatigue of welds, composites and polymers
Failure analysis methodology: evidence gathering, visual inspection and fractography (beach marks, striations)
Root-cause analysis tools: fault trees, fishbone diagrams and FMEA
Classic case studies: Liberty ships, Comet airliner, Aloha 243, Challenger O-rings, Columbia foam strike
